Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join assays on chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1267250'. Join activities on assay_id. Join molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno. Filter standard_relation = '=' and standard_value is not null and standard_relation is not null. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
